      hint: declare the group only if the user is meant to administer the node; Mamela never removes a membership, so taking it out of the declaration later does not take it away
    warning MAM-PLAN-0148 user app on web is also in group adm, which the declaration does not name: Mamela adds memberships and never removes one, so it stays
      hint: declare the group if it is meant, or take the user out of it by hand (gpasswd -d app adm)
